confidentiality.title: Notice of Confidentiality
confidentiality.body: The information you enter here is confidential and private to your account. It is intended only for you and the professionals you choose to send it to.

privacy.title: Health Information Privacy Notice
privacy.body: SA CoParents is not a healthcare provider, health plan or healthcare clearinghouse, so the federal HIPAA law generally does not apply to this app. We still protect what you enter: it is private to your account, encrypted while it travels between your device and our servers, and never shared with your co-parent, a court or anyone else unless you choose to share it. Please do not enter Social Security numbers, insurance member ID numbers or other account numbers.

notices.ack_label: I have read the Notice of Confidentiality and the Health Information Privacy Notice.
notices.ack_required: Please tick the box to confirm you've read the notices before saving.
